name: Effective Range / Positive Teaching Dimension
details: Refuted: positive teaching dimension need not be finite, even on a finite domain.
proof: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, the empty concept has no positive examples. Its only positive sample is therefore empty, which every cube concept realizes; it cannot be a positive teaching set. Hence $\mathrm{TD}^+(2^{[n]})=\infty$, while the effective range is $n$.
witness_verification: For every $n\ge1$, the full cube has effective range $n$ and positive teaching dimension $\infty$ because the empty concept has no finite positive teaching set. Thus the proposed reverse inequality fails more strongly than by an unbounded finite gap.
